kute01.title: 1 a.m., typing to the ex
kute01.caption:
1 a.m., thumb hovering over the ex's name.
You can miss someone and still not send it.

kute02.title: Asking them to dinner, attempt nine
kute02.caption:
Nine drafts to ask one simple question?
The plain version was the brave one all along.

kute03.title: The old friend you lost touch with
kute03.caption:
A year of silence and twelve drafts of hi.
They will probably just be happy to hear from you.

kute04.title: Texting mom after the fight
kute04.caption:
That text to mom after a fight you keep rewriting.
Saying sorry first is not losing.

kute05.title: Typing "congrats" and mostly meaning it
kute05.caption:
When their good news stings a little.
You can feel envy and still send real joy.

kute06.title: Virgo's text has footnotes
kute06.caption:
Wrote a full essay to say one feeling?
Ten honest words land better than ten paragraphs.

kute07.title: "So... what are we?" draft six
kute07.caption:
Trying to ask what this is without sounding like you're asking.
Ask clearly, then listen kindly.

kute08.title: Scorpio typed "k."
kute08.caption:
Typed k. and meant a whole paragraph.
Saying you're hurt opens a door that k. shuts.

kute09.title: Cancelling plans, again
kute09.caption:
Cancelling on a friend for the third time this month?
Own it and offer a real plan.

kute10.title: Capricorn trying to say "proud of you"
kute10.caption:
Why is 'proud of you' so hard to type?
Warm words don't need the perfect moment.

kute11.title: They said "I like you." Aquarius:
kute11.caption:
They said it first and you typed lol same.
A real feeling deserves a real reply.

kute12.title: 3 a.m., Pisces is drafting
kute12.caption:
3 a.m. and writing to someone from nine months ago?
Put it in a notebook and sleep on it.

kute13.title: Aries typing angry
kute13.caption:
Typing in all caps at the group chat?
Give it an hour. The calm version says it better.

kute14.title: Ending it kindly
kute14.caption:
How do you end something without being cruel?
Clear and honest is the kindest goodbye.

kute15.title: Replying three weeks late
kute15.caption:
That message you left for three weeks.
A late, honest reply still beats none.

kute16.title: The ex's birthday
kute16.caption:
Their birthday, and your thumb won't stop hovering.
Some wishes can stay in your heart.

kute17.title: Leo typed "i'm fine" again
kute17.caption:
Typed 'i'm fine' for the hundredth time?
Asking for help is strong too.

kute18.title: Virgo said sorry nine times
kute18.caption:
Do you apologise before every question?
Drop the extra sorrys. You're allowed to ask.

kute19.title: Libra about to say yes again
kute19.caption:
Saying yes when your whole body says rest.
A kind no beats a tired yes.

kute20.title: Texting your best friend... feelings
kute20.caption:
Catching feelings for your best friend.
Some words deserve a face, not a screen.

kute21.title: Their time: 4 a.m.
kute21.caption:
When it's evening for you and 4 a.m. for them.
Send the soft one. It will still be there when they wake.

kute22.title: Making a friend as an adult
kute22.caption:
Why is asking a new friend to hang out so scary?
Friendship needs asking too.

kute23.title: Five unsent texts, one night
kute23.caption:
Five texts drafted, four never sent. Wait for the last one.
The drafts show you what you actually mean.

kute24.title: One text, all night
kute24.caption:
One text, rewritten from 11 p.m. to 9 a.m.
The angry drafts faded. The true one kept.
